risk_note: RV1 by path, handled as RV2 (编排 19:54; FU-ADMIN-REALNAME-CORRECTION-MIN-AGE). The admin realname correction judged the age line with the constant MIN_REALNAME_AGE = 14 (admin-realname-correction.ts:261) while App submission reads minor.min_realname_age since B1-02zzg. It now reuses B1-02zzg's readMinRealnameAge: a safe integer 14..18 is used, anything else (no row, read failure, invalid, out of range) is 14 — never looser; a read failure still judges (no 50001); the fallback warn carries only app / key / reason (no ID number, no name). Read after the blocklist check (step 4) and before the duplicate check (step 6), holding no transaction or lock. Wiring: the admin entry does not install IdentityModule and app.module is outside the paths, so identity-admin.module passes the content per-app/per-key config reader already given to the admin module (options.dataCopyCalendar(db, clock), pool-bound); the rule tests through the real admin entry are green on it. A dedicated name in app.module can come later. Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21).
